---
name: 🚀 Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for the AI Delivery Control framework.
title: 'feat: [Short description of the feature]'
labels: enhancement, untriaged
assignees: ''
---

### Is your feature request related to a problem?
A clear and concise description of what the problem is (e.g., "I'm frustrated when...").

### Describe the Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen. Explain how the proposed feature fits into our goals of portability, high-trust, and low pre-commit overhead.

### Describe Alternatives Considered
A clear and concise description of any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

### Worked Example or Mockup
Provide any configuration examples, workflow layouts, or CLI output mocks to help visualize the feature.

### Additional Context
Add any other context or screenshots about the feature request here.
